judgment: and seek what fills your own mouth.
image: So the noble one is careful with words,
lines: against the constant way, fed from the hill.
Against the jaws: holding firm, misfortune.
You cannot ford the great river.
It is good to ford the great river.

notes.name_en: 頤 is the jaw/cheeks (and feeding); concrete 'Jaws', not Wilhelm's 'Corners of the Mouth / Nourishment'.
notes.L1: 靈龜 the sacred tortoise (that lives on air) dropped to watch another eat; 朵頤 jaws drooping/moving with food.
